description: A broad introduction to the field of microbiology. Prokaryotic and eukaryotic cell structure and function; physiology and growth of microorganisms; control of microbial growth; viruses; molecular taxonomy of microorganisms.
preAndCorequisites:
• Minimum second-year standing
  • or permission of the department.
supplementalNotes: • Credit will be granted for only one of MICR 200A, MICR 200.
title: Introductory Microbiology I
